question: 单项选择：My mother asked me _____ the room. A. clean  B. to clean  C. cleaning  D. cleaned
answer: 答案：B. to clean。解析：ask sb. to do"请某人做"。整句：My mother asked me to clean the room.

question: 单项选择：She wants me _____ her with the housework. A. help  B. to help  C. helping  D. helps
answer: 答案：B. to help。解析：want sb. to do"想要某人做"。housework"家务"。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：The teacher told us ______ (read) the text loudly.
answer: 答案：to read。解析：tell sb. to do"告诉某人做"。loudly"大声地"。

question: 单项选择：I would like you _____ me a favor. A. help  B. to help  C. helping  D. helps
answer: 答案：B. to help。解析：would like sb. to do"想让某人做"。a favor"帮忙"。

question: 翻译句子：他鼓励我不要放弃。
answer: 答案：He encouraged me not to give up. 解析：encourage sb. not to do"鼓励某人不做"。give up"放弃"。

question: 单项选择：Please ask him _____ here earlier next time. A. come  B. to come  C. coming  D. comes
answer: 答案：B. to come。解析：ask sb. to do"请某人做"。earlier"更早"。next time"下次"。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：She invited me ______ (attend) her birthday party.
answer: 答案：to attend。解析：invite sb. to do"邀请某人做"。birthday party"生日派对"。

question: 单项选择：My father taught me _____ the bike when I was young. A. ride  B. to ride  C. riding  D. rides
answer: 答案：B. to ride。解析：teach sb. to do"教某人做"。bike"自行车"。

question: 翻译句子：我希望你能帮我学英语。
answer: 答案：I hope you can help me to learn English. 或 I hope you can help me learn English. 解析：help sb. (to) do"帮助某人做"，to可以省略。

question: 单项选择：The doctor advised him _____ more water. A. drink  B. to drink  C. drinking  D. drinks
answer: 答案：B. to drink。解析：advise sb. to do"建议某人做"。more water"多喝水"。
